events.verdict: Leonard (POR) establishes himself in a screening position in Bradley's (LAC) defensive path after the hand-off and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) sets the back-screen on Aminu (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Curry (POR) makes high-five contact with Gallinari's (LAC) hand after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Leonard (POR) creates contact with Harrell's (LAC) right forearm during the put-back and affects the shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Leonard (POR) enters the lane prior to the release of Harrell's (LAC) free throw attempt.
Aminu (POR) sets the pick on Bradley (LAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Gallinari (LAC) places his right hand against Lillard's (POR) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Gallinari (LAC) legally contests Lillard's (POR) jump shot attempt on the wing.
MOB/LLB show McCollum (POR) does not maintain legal guarding position when he makes contact to Gallinari's (LAC) arm during his upward shooting motion.
The timeout is called prior to a five second violation.
LAR shows Bradley (LAC) places his hand against Lillard's (POR) backside and briefly grasps his jersey. This contact is marginal and does not affect Lillard's FOM.
Bradley (LAC) briefly grasps Lillard's (POR) jersey without affecting his FOM prior to the inbound taking place.
Bradley (LAC) places his forearm against Lillard's (POR) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Harris (LAC) makes incidental contact to Leonard's (POR) arm that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Beverley (LAC) makes marginal contact to McCollum's (POR) front that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Turner (POR) makes marginal body contact with Williams (LAC) that does not affect his SQBR during his dribble.
Turner (POR) commits the take foul on Beverley (LAC) in the corner.
